answer: Require every agent identity to stake tokens that slowly decay unless the agent completes real economic work verified by its trading counterparties. A sybil swarm multiplying identities spreads its stake thin, like pigment diluted in too much water, and each fake decays before it can act. A coordinated burst of fake identities trying to move a market sends a ripple through the attestation graph that peers notice and discount together, the way an audience hears when a sonnet stumbles off meter: the cadence of genuine trade is hard to fake at scale.
